entries.name: B-roll from location
entries.description: Generate a short b-roll clip for a location from its description.

entries.name: Character turnaround sheet
entries.description: Generate (or reuse) a character portrait, then expand it into a multi-view turnaround sheet.

entries.name: Cold open two-shot
entries.description: Episodic cold open — location exterior, two series leads composited in, animated two-shot.

entries.name: Cover art from track
entries.description: Turn a track or album description into cover art via a short art-direction pass.

entries.name: Location description to establishing shot
entries.description: Paint (or reuse) a location exterior and animate it into a short establishing clip.

entries.name: Item render and 3D turntable
entries.description: Render an item hero image, then derive a game-ready 3D model from it.

entries.name: Lyrics to looped shots
entries.description: Split a song into looped shot clips — optional vocal stem, per-shot still, image-to-video.

entries.name: Prop from item
entries.description: Turn an item into a textured 3D prop, then render a turntable preview in Blender.

entries.name: Video from an approved frame
entries.description: Pass one approved story-sheet frame and a motion brief to a video step.

entries.name: Character headshot candidate
entries.description: Draft a headshot from selected character traits for review before use as a reference.

entries.name: Story sheet candidate
entries.description: Combine approved character references with a selected location and brand artwork for review.

entries.name: Character turnaround candidate
entries.description: Use an approved headshot and the character's selected traits to draft a full-body turnaround.

entries.name: Location still, two leads, then video
entries.description: Generate or reuse a location exterior, place two character portraits, animate the still.

entries.name: Score under track
entries.description: Generate a music bed from a brief and mix it under a video's existing audio.

entries.name: Stem split
entries.description: Split a track into vocal and instrumental stems for remixing or beat-matching.

entries.name: Track to music video
entries.description: From a song/entity description, make a hero still and an image-to-video clip.
